messages.author: 96e275f43eafb053
messages.subject: Improving smoothness of Predicted Maps
parts:
Hi All,
I am trying to plot smooth maps for the posterior predicted mean and sd but the ones I am getting seems to have some pattern. I have attached predicted mean map above.

I used the following code to create triangulation:
mesh.dummy<-inla.mesh.create(loc=borders,extend=list(n=16,offset =1 ),refine=FALSE)
boundary<-inla.mesh.boundary(mesh.dummy)
mesh<-inla.mesh.create(boundary=boundary,
                       refine=list(max.edge=1))

Initially I thought that by increasing the number of messes, the smoothness of the maps would improve but it did not.
How can I improve smoothness of the predicted maps.

Many Thanks

Those horizontal effects should not appear at all. Since they are on a
smaller scale than the spde mesh triangles the effect must come from
somewhere else.

What method do you use for producing the figures?
Do the horizontal effects appear when using image() and/or
levelplot()

Finn
